review_evidence: Reviewed all 52 primary Lean files. QPFTypes contains interaction-tree definitions, quotient/polynomial-functor constructions, heterogeneous-equality lemmas, macro-generated data constructions, and formal examples/tests exercising those interfaces.

A complete hydrated-source declaration scan found 385 definition/theorem/lemma/structure/class/inductive/instance-style declarations; the Qpf and utility modules contain reusable formal type-theoretic statements and proofs.
Test/example files instantiate the same formal interfaces and can carry useful declaration and syntax prior art; no safe source-local hard-exclusion class was established.
summary: Reviewed QPFTypes and retain its type-theoretic constructions, lemmas, generated-form examples and formal tests.
